title: Intermediate Components Are Kept Out of the Loop

blocks.content: Intermediate Components Are Kept Out of the Loop
We said useTheme() reaches the Provider directly. But what about the components in between?
Here's the good news: you do not need to import or use ThemeContext in any component that just sits between the Provider and the consumer.
If HomePage renders EntryCard, and only EntryCard needs the theme, HomePage doesn't need to know about context at all. The consumer reaches the Provider directly.
This is the key difference from props:

items: With props, every layer in the chain must accept and forward the value.
With context, intermediate components are completely out of the picture.
